The build process uses `cmake` and `make` as expected for a C++ project, with no use of dangerous or obfuscated commands.

It also modifies the CMakeLists.txt to prefer system libraries over bundled ones, which is a standard packaging practice to reduce bloat and improve security via system-wide updates.

The individual `package_*` functions install built artifacts to appropriate system directories and include license files. No network operations, file manipulations outside the build directory, or unexpected system modifications occur during packaging. All actions are consistent with standard AUR packaging practices and serve the legitimate purpose of building and installing the plugin.
